map.name: Tolmar Cross
map.setting: a crossroads inn and its hamlet
map.trouble: The Trolls of Glumm Hollow have overrun the North Bridge and dragged off the wizard Quillon, and the north road is cut until he is brought back. Brannoch, an old road captain, sent the player here to Warden Orsk.

guard_bark.specifics: Gurm, a guard at the crossroads post, talks of the Trolls at the North Bridge.

first.speaker: Gurm
first.text: Keep your chin up, stranger, the Trolls will break on our spears!

again.speaker: Gurm
again.text: We must hold the line and repay those who were lost on the bridge!

later.speaker: Gurm
later.text: I feel a strange hope on the road today! Is there any news at all from the Hollow?

bounty_offer.specifics: Bessa Tuck, a cider brewer, wants a bear out of the shed by her hop yard; the hornets sting everyone. She pays in a ferry pass.

offer.speaker: Bessa Tuck
offer.text:
Good! My family brews the finest cider in Tolmar Cross. Unfortunately, a foul great bear has moved into the shed near our hop yard. He has stirred up the hornets and now they sting anyone who goes into the yard.

Go and kill the bear, then come back and I'll sign your ferry pass.

Here, take this iron key, it opens the yard gate.

reminder.speaker: Bessa Tuck
reminder.text: Don't fret, one old bear is no great threat. Come back when it's been put down.

completion.speaker: Bessa Tuck
completion.text:
Excellent! The bear is dead.

Here is your ferry pass. Show it to Ibb and he'll put you on the ferry. Good luck!

journal.text: Kill the Bear troubling Tuck's hop yard.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Hessel, the stablemaster, lost his Cloak of Warding to crows and imps that overran the stable loft.

offer.speaker: Hessel
offer.text:
Why did you take so long!? We have a terrible problem!

Hideous overgrown crows and flying imps from the Hollow have overrun the stable loft. Two of my stablehands were hurt in defense of the inn's good name!

Please, I beg you! Will you drive off the beasts and fetch back my Cloak of Warding? I'll pay you handsomely.

This key will open the loft door.

I also have a potion that might come in handy.

refusal.speaker: Hessel
refusal.text: No? Well, the cloak is still up there. Come back if you change your mind.

reminder.speaker: Hessel
reminder.text: Come back to me once the loft is clear and the cloak is mine again, and you'll be paid well.

completion.speaker: Hessel
completion.text:
You are a true champion! My deepest thanks.

While you were up in the loft, fighting those crows, Orsk came by, looking for you. He's waiting for you at the Warden's Post -- north of here.

Take this gold and potion for your trouble, before you go.

after.speaker: Hessel
after.text: Orsk is no fool. Best do as he says.

journal.text: Kill the crows and imps in Hessel's stable loft. Recover the Cloak of Warding.

journal_done.text: Go to the Warden's Post and speak with Orsk.

rumour.specifics: Lorna flirts, Wick the drunk taunts, Dray wants the Troll chief dead.

rumour1.speaker: Lorna
rumour1.text: Hello stranger! Look me up when you're done with the Trolls.

rumour2.speaker: Wick
rumour2.text: Watcha gonna do? Throw me out?

rumour3.speaker: Dray
rumour3.text: Get that Troll chief and tear his tusks out!

shop_greeting.specifics: Pegg keeps the inn, Kolb the arms shop, Zillah the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Pegg
inn.text: Maybe you'd like a hot meal or a room?

arms.speaker: Kolb
arms.text:
Stranger from the south, eh? Most folk around here don't trust your sort, but they've never even been to the Hollow and I have! What do they know!? Eh? Heh, heh, heh...

You're always welcome here, sir.

magic.speaker: Zillah
magic.text: Watch your step in my shop, stranger! I've got plenty of scrolls here that'll singe your eyebrows off.

two_givers.specifics: Tarn, the mule race marshal, takes entries for a fee. Odo Grubb sells a mule to anyone going in the race.

offer_a.speaker: Tarn
offer_a.text:
Are you entering the mule race? If so, you'll want your own mule and an entry fee of 30 gold pieces. We provide the saddle.

Well? Shall I put your name down?

offer_b.speaker: Odo Grubb
offer_b.text:
I guess you're after the mule race, eh. I've got a real fine mule for sale.

Seeing as I like your face, I'll let her go for 90 gold. Are you interested?

outcome_a.speaker: Tarn
outcome_a.text: Alright. The fee is paid. Go on to the start. The marshal will explain how it works. Good luck.

outcome_b.speaker: Odo Grubb
outcome_b.text: There ya go! That mule was made for you. You can't lose the race on a mule like that.

journal_a.text: Pay Tarn the entry fee for the mule race.

journal_b.text: Buy the mule from Odo Grubb.

rescue.specifics: Dessa's boy Tibb is trapped in the root cellar with wolves at the door.

plea.speaker: Dessa
plea.text:
These cursed wolves are worse than the mange! My husband tried to chase them off, but they always return! My only hope is that you somehow drive the wolves off and get my boy out!

Tibb is in the root cellar, there, past the barn doors. Please, be careful.

reminder.speaker: Dessa
reminder.text: I shall not leave this door till my boy is out! Pull him out of there! And drive them off! Hurry before they get through!

found.speaker: Tibb
found.text: Is somebody there? Please, get me out of here!

following.speaker: Tibb
following.text: Please take me home to Ma!

completion.speaker: Dessa
completion.text:
Kind sir, my warmest thanks! You have earned a bed at the Split Post. The innkeeper will be told that you are now free to stay there as you please.

Take this gold and potion for your trouble. I insist.

journal.text: Drive off the wolves and free Tibb in Dessa's cellar.

main_opening.specifics: Fitch points the player to Orsk, who sends him to Glumm Hollow to rescue Quillon from the Trolls.

herald.speaker: Fitch
herald.text: Welcome! I hear you're the one Orsk has been waiting for!

opening.speaker: Orsk
opening.text:
Blast! Where have you been, lad!? The Trolls swarmed the North Bridge and we'd have lost it to them if Quillon's fiery spells had not been hurled in at the last moment!

But in the thick of it, the brutes dragged Quillon off, leaving the broken bridge our smallest worry! The whole north road is in peril if Quillon is lost!

You must go where Quillon was taken, north to the Troll Den of Glumm Hollow! Bring Quillon back or we are doomed!

reminder.speaker: Orsk
reminder.text: I'm sure Quillon's in deep trouble! Move fast!

journal.text: Go to Glumm Hollow and free Quillon.
